crossRefs.note: When he was in distress, he begged Yahweh his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers.
“Behold, I am of small account. What will I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.
I had heard of you by the hearing of the ear, but now my eye sees you.
Therefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.”

translations.web: Let him put his mouth in the dust, if it is so that there may be hope.
translations.bsb: Let him bury his face in the dust— perhaps there is still hope.
translations.kjv: He putteth his mouth in the dust; if so be there may be hope.
